claim: For tape-reading games the record's snapshot is the emulator start state and tapes are alternative input sets; every set must rebuild the same outputs.

evidence.text: Start state is the record's snapshot (128K game loaded from Side A in an emulator, world 1 in memory); Side B .tzx supplies world block 37, which Side A lacks.
evidence.quote: Start state = the record's snapshot: the 128K game loaded from Side A in an emulator

evidence.text: Tapes are inputs.tapes alternative sets in order; every set must rebuild the same outputs (the .tap and the .tzx give the same bytes).
evidence.quote: every set must rebuild the same outputs
